messages:
Alice (acme-corp): Hi team — we got our March invoice and there's a ~120k token spike for a single request that should've been ~1.2k. Can anyone explain?
Mia (support): Sorry about that, Alice. Can you share the request_id or the timestamp (UTC) for the call? Also which SDK/version and model?
Alice (acme-corp): Timestamp 2025-11-02T15:22:10Z, model redwood-open-7b, request_id in our logs is missing (client logs show 3 POSTs). Using the official JS SDK v1.4.0.
Sam (billing): Pulling ledger entries for that window now. I see three metering rows at 15:22:10/11/12 UTC all billed to your account, similar token counts ~40k each — looks like three separate charges.
Jordan (infra): Can you paste the client-side snippet showing headers? Curious if an Idempotency-Key was used.
Alice (acme-corp): Here's the snippet we use (copied from our code):
```
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload)
})
```
We didn't set `Idempotency-Key` explicitly.
Mia (support): That aligns with the ledger. On our side the gateway returned `504` to the client (connection timeout) at 15:22:10, then the client retried immediately (15:22:11) and once more (15:22:12). Because no idempotency key was present, each retry created a new consumption line.
Jordan (infra): Adding trace output from the edge logs for that timeframe:
```
[15:22:10.112] ingress: req=abc123 upstream=up-01 status=504
[15:22:11.204] ingress: req=def456 upstream=up-02 status=200
[15:22:12.330] ingress: req=ghi789 upstream=up-03 status=200
```
Note: `req` is our internal request id. The client-generated idempotency header was blank, so we treated them as separate requests.
Sam (billing): For reconciliation: ledger shows 3 completed usage rows. Invoice system rolled those into the final invoice. We can issue a refund/credit for the extra two runs pending confirmation from infra that these are genuine retries.
Mia (support): Alice — would you like us to credit the two duplicate runs while we harden the gateway?
Alice (acme-corp): Yes please, that would be great. This caused a big surprise in our billing.
Jordan (infra): Plan to mitigate: 1) Short-term: enforce best-effort dedupe at edge when `Idempotency-Key` header present + payload fingerprint match (will deploy small config change). 2) Medium-term: add a 60s idempotency window server-side keyed by `Idempotency-Key` and payload-hash to dedupe across retries. 3) Docs & SDK: Mia/Docs team please add example showing how to set `Idempotency-Key`.
Mia (support): I'll file a docs request and ping devex. Also will send a quick how-to to Alice with sample code.
Sam (billing): I'll prepare the credit: refund for two runs (~80k tokens) as a one-time credit, pending infra ticket #INF-4521. Will post the credit reference here when done.
Alice (acme-corp): Thanks — appreciate the quick response. Small ask: can infra also log when gateway returns 5xx vs 504 so we can correlate in our client?
Jordan (infra): Good idea — adding a structured header `X-RW-Retry-Advice` in error responses so clients can detect transient gateway timeouts vs user errors. Will include in the INF-4521 changes.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy INF-4521 to staging at 2025-11-03T02:00:00Z and to prod 2025-11-03T10:00:00Z (rollout: canary 10%).
Mia (support): Credit posted: REF-2025-11-02-ACME-001. Alice, you should see it applied to your account balance within 24h.
Alice (acme-corp): I see the credit reflected, thank you. We'll also add `Idempotency-Key` on our side today. Can you confirm the recommended pattern?
Mia (support): Suggested pattern: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid-v4>` per user action + include `body-hash` when retrying identical payloads. We'll send the snippet to you.
Jordan (infra): Note for engineering: make sure dedupe logic considers identical prompt + model + temperature combos; otherwise we might accidentally collapse legitimately distinct calls. Filed INF-4521 with details.
Sam (billing): Closing: billing credit queued, INF-4521 created, docs update requested. Reopen if anything else. :thumbsup:
